repo.description:
### Impact

A flaw in how replies to whisper posts are handled allows authenticated users outside the groups configured in `whispers_allowed_groups` to post into a topic's staff-only whisper channel. The injected content is visible to whisperers (typically staff) alongside legitimate whispers. Only sites that have whispers enabled are affected.

### Patches

Upgrade to the patched version.

### Workarounds

Administrators of sites that do not need whispers can clear the `whispers_allowed_groups` site setting until the patch is applied; sites   with no groups configured for that setting are not affected. Sites that rely on whispers should upgrade to a patched version.
repo.summary: Replying to a whisper lets non-whisperers create staff-only whisper posts
